route.reason: Indications for dupilumab come from its FDA drug label.

draft.text: Dupilumab (DUPIXENT), an interleukin-4 receptor alpha antagonist, is indicated for several conditions [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:0]. Atopic dermatitis: moderate-to-severe AD in patients aged 6 months and older not adequately controlled with topical prescription therapies or when those therapies are not advisable [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:0]. Asthma: add-on maintenance treatment in patients aged 6 years and older with moderate-to-severe eosinophilic-phenotype or oral corticosteroid-dependent asthma, not for acute bronchospasm or status asthmaticus [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:0]. Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps: add-on maintenance treatment in patients aged 12 years and older with inadequately controlled CRSwNP [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]. Eosinophilic esophagitis: patients aged 1 year and older weighing at least 15 kg [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]. Prurigo nodularis: adults [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]. COPD: add-on maintenance treatment in adults with inadequately controlled COPD and an eosinophilic phenotype, not for acute bronchospasm [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]. Chronic spontaneous urticaria: patients aged 2 years and older who remain symptomatic despite H1 antihistamine treatment, not for other forms of urticaria [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:2]. Bullous pemphigoid: adults [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:3]. Allergic fungal rhinosinusitis: patients aged 6 years and older with a history of sino-nasal surgery [label:dupilumab:indications_and_usage:3].
